extras: Disclaimer: This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by TMDb.
intentEvidence: Generate and manage movie-related notes using IMDb identifiers or movie titles.
motivation: To provide a better way to document movie collections than using plain text.
problem: Manually creating detailed, structured notes about movies and TV shows is time-consuming and requires external data gathering.

requires.name: TMDb API key or TMDb Access Token

summary: Popcorn-MD allows users to search for movies and TV shows using TMDb and automatically generates structured notes with metadata using customizable templates.
